title: Sono
description: Duração, estágios, sleep score e horários de cada noite contra a meta; a noite conta no dia em que termina.

targets.rawSql:
with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local
),
sleep as (
  select s.samsung_uid, s.sleep_score, s.period_start_local, s.period_end_local,
         cast(s.period_end_local as date) as day,
         coalesce(s.duration_seconds, extract(epoch from s.period_end - s.period_start)) as duration_seconds
  from read_model.current_sleep s, period
  where s.period_end_local >= period.from_local and s.period_end_local < period.to_local
),
longest as (
  select distinct on (day) day, samsung_uid, sleep_score, period_start_local, period_end_local,
         sum(duration_seconds) over (partition by day) as total_seconds
  from sleep
  order by day, sleep.duration_seconds desc, sleep.period_end_local desc, sleep.samsung_uid
),
nightly as (
  select l.day, l.samsung_uid, l.total_seconds, l.sleep_score, l.period_start_local, l.period_end_local,
         extract(epoch from cast(l.period_start_local as time))
           + case when cast(l.period_start_local as time) < time '12:00' then 86400 else 0 end as bed_seconds,
         extract(epoch from cast(l.period_end_local as time)) as wake_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.wake_up_time - g.bed_time)
           + case when g.wake_up_time < g.bed_time then 86400 else 0 end as target_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.bed_time)
           + case when g.bed_time < time '12:00' then 86400 else 0 end as goal_bed_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.wake_up_time) as goal_wake_seconds
  from longest l
  left join read_model.current_daily_goal g on g.goal = 'sleep_goal' and g.day = l.day
)
select avg(total_seconds) as "Duração média",
       avg(sleep_score) as "Score médio",
       avg(bed_seconds) as "Deitar médio",
       avg(wake_seconds) as "Acordar médio",
       format('%s de %s', count(*) filter (where total_seconds >= target_seconds), count(target_seconds)) as "Noites na meta"
from nightly

         cast(s.period_end_local as date) as day,
         coalesce(s.duration_seconds, extract(epoch from s.period_end - s.period_start)) as duration_seconds
  from read_model.current_sleep s, period
  where s.period_end_local >= period.from_local and s.period_end_local < period.to_local
),
longest as (
  select distinct on (day) day, samsung_uid, sleep_score, period_start_local, period_end_local,
         sum(duration_seconds) over (partition by day) as total_seconds
  from sleep
  order by day, sleep.duration_seconds desc, sleep.period_end_local desc, sleep.samsung_uid
),
nightly as (
  select l.day, l.samsung_uid, l.total_seconds, l.sleep_score, l.period_start_local, l.period_end_local,
         extract(epoch from cast(l.period_start_local as time))
           + case when cast(l.period_start_local as time) < time '12:00' then 86400 else 0 end as bed_seconds,
         extract(epoch from cast(l.period_end_local as time)) as wake_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.wake_up_time - g.bed_time)
           + case when g.wake_up_time < g.bed_time then 86400 else 0 end as target_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.bed_time)
           + case when g.bed_time < time '12:00' then 86400 else 0 end as goal_bed_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.wake_up_time) as goal_wake_seconds
  from longest l
  left join read_model.current_daily_goal g on g.goal = 'sleep_goal' and g.day = l.day
)
select read_model.local_bucket(case when '$agrupar' = 'hour' then 'day' else '$agrupar' end, n.day::timestamp) at time zone '$__timezone' as time,
       avg(n.total_seconds) as "Duração",
       avg(n.target_seconds) as "Meta",
       case when '$agrupar' in ('hour', 'day') then min(n.samsung_uid) end as samsung_uid,
       case when '$agrupar' in ('hour', 'day') then cast(cast(extract(epoch from (min(n.period_start_local) - interval '30 minutes') at time zone '$__timezone') * 1000 as bigint) as text) end as "from",
       case when '$agrupar' in ('hour', 'day') then cast(cast(extract(epoch from (max(n.period_end_local) + interval '30 minutes') at time zone '$__timezone') * 1000 as bigint) as text) end as "to"
from nightly n
group by 1
order by 1

with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local
),
sleep as (

         cast(s.period_end_local as date) as day,

),
longest as (

         sum(duration_seconds) over (partition by day) as total_seconds
  from sleep
  order by day, sleep.duration_seconds desc, sleep.period_end_local desc, sleep.samsung_uid
),
nightly as (
  select l.day, l.samsung_uid, l.total_seconds, l.sleep_score, l.period_start_local, l.period_end_local,
         extract(epoch from cast(l.period_start_local as time))
           + case when cast(l.period_start_local as time) < time '12:00' then 86400 else 0 end as bed_seconds,
         extract(epoch from cast(l.period_end_local as time)) as wake_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.wake_up_time - g.bed_time)
           + case when g.wake_up_time < g.bed_time then 86400 else 0 end as target_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.bed_time)
           + case when g.bed_time < time '12:00' then 86400 else 0 end as goal_bed_seconds,
         extract(epoch from g.wake_up_time) as goal_wake_seconds
  from longest l
  left join read_model.current_daily_goal g on g.goal = 'sleep_goal' and g.day = l.day
),
stage as (
  select s.day,
         sum(extract(epoch from st.end_at - st.start_at)) filter (where case st.stage when 'AWAKE' then 'Acordado' when 'REM' then 'REM' when 'LIGHT' then 'Leve' when 'DEEP' then 'Profundo' else 'Indefinido' end = 'Acordado') as "Acordado",
         sum(extract(epoch from st.end_at - st.start_at)) filter (where case st.stage when 'AWAKE' then 'Acordado' when 'REM' then 'REM' when 'LIGHT' then 'Leve' when 'DEEP' then 'Profundo' else 'Indefinido' end = 'REM') as "REM",
         sum(extract(epoch from st.end_at - st.start_at)) filter (where case st.stage when 'AWAKE' then 'Acordado' when 'REM' then 'REM' when 'LIGHT' then 'Leve' when 'DEEP' then 'Profundo' else 'Indefinido' end = 'Leve') as "Leve",
         sum(extract(epoch from st.end_at - st.start_at)) filter (where case st.stage when 'AWAKE' then 'Acordado' when 'REM' then 'REM' when 'LIGHT' then 'Leve' when 'DEEP' then 'Profundo' else 'Indefinido' end = 'Profundo') as "Profundo",
         sum(extract(epoch from st.end_at - st.start_at)) filter (where case st.stage when 'AWAKE' then 'Acordado' when 'REM' then 'REM' when 'LIGHT' then 'Leve' when 'DEEP' then 'Profundo' else 'Indefinido' end = 'Indefinido') as "Indefinido"
  from sleep s
  join read_model.current_sleep_stage st on st.samsung_uid = s.samsung_uid
  group by s.day
)
select read_model.local_bucket(case when '$agrupar' = 'hour' then 'day' else '$agrupar' end, n.day::timestamp) at time zone '$__timezone' as time,
       avg(coalesce(st."Acordado", 0)) as "Acordado",
       avg(coalesce(st."REM", 0)) as "REM",
       avg(coalesce(st."Leve", 0)) as "Leve",
       avg(coalesce(st."Profundo", 0)) as "Profundo",
       avg(coalesce(st."Indefinido", 0)) as "Indefinido"
from nightly n
left join stage st on st.day = n.day
group by 1
order by 1

panels.title: Histórico de apneia
panels.description: Todo o histórico, independente do período.

targets.rawSql:
select to_char(cast(period_end_local as date), 'DD/MM/YYYY') as "Dia",
       case result when 'DETECTED' then 'Detectado' when 'NOT_DETECTED' then 'Não detectado' else 'Indefinido' end as "Resultado"
from read_model.current_sleep_apnea
order by period_end desc
